_note: REAL MONEY, backtest sizing at tiny scale: x_exit only (real-money backtest, Oct 18 - Nov 1 final exam at these limits: +$30.97, t 2.27, 12/17 winning days, vs +$12.08 / t 0.85 for the 3-rule mix; account holder's choice 2026-11-05), the backtest's Kelly sizing on a $0.50 base (up to 5x = $2.50 on the strongest gaps), at most 10 contracts; when a signal is worth less than one contract, exactly 1 contract is bought if it costs at most $1 (the backtest takes those trades at fractional size).
